description: This file defines a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' that manages the process of generating, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions using AI models, vector stores, and image analysis. It includes methods for context retrieval, question generation, validation, and citation addition, with a focus on ensuring question uniqueness and quality.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: A class that orchestrates the process of generating, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions using AI and vector search techniques.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the QuestionGeneratorNodes with AI client, embedding manager, image processor, vector store, and storage, along with caches.

methods.name: _get_cached_questions
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter with caching to reduce disk I/O.

methods.name: _calculate_question_similarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: _extract_medical_terms
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: _is_question_unique
methods.description: Checks if a question is unique compared to existing questions based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: _extract_covered_topics
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions to avoid repetition.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores
methods.description: Tracks quality scores for source chunks to prioritize high-quality content.

methods.name: retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context from vector store with smart selection based on difficulty and covered topics.

methods.name: generate_question
methods.description: Generates a new question using AI, incorporating context and image analysis, and checks for uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_accuracy
methods.description: Validates the generated question for medical accuracy and quality.

methods.name: add_citations
methods.description: Finalizes the question by adding source metadata, confidence scores, and updating quality metrics.
